statBlock.name: Tridrone
statBlock.description: An inverted-pyramid modron that leads lesser modrons in battle.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the tridrone to act against its nature or instructions.
Disintegration. When the tridrone dies, its body turns to dust. Its weapons and anything else it carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Fist attacks or three Javelin attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Tridrone (Rogue)
statBlock.classification: Medium construct, any alignment except lawful neutral
statBlock.description: A tridrone that has broken with Primus. Other modrons track it down.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. When the tridrone dies, its body turns to dust. Its weapons and anything else it carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Fist attacks or three Javelin attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 224 for the Rogue Modron sidebar and p. 225 for the tridrone.
sections.Variant: The Rogue Modron variant removes Axiomatic Mind and changes the alignment to any except lawful neutral. Use the tridrone statistics for all other rules.

statBlock.name: Faerie Dragon (Blue)
statBlock.description: A cat-sized dragon with blue scales and butterfly wings. This color marks a faerie dragon 31–40 years old.

sections.Traits:
Limited Telepathy. The dragon can communicate magically with other faerie dragons within 60 ft.
Magic Resistance. The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
Innate Spellcasting. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The dragon casts these spells without material components.
1/day each: Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Color Spray, Mirror Image, Suggestion, Major Image.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 1 piercing damage.
Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6). Exhale gas at one creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the effect lasts 1 minute and the target cannot take reactions. At the start of each of its turns while affected, the target rolls 1d6.
1–4. It takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
5–6. It stays still and can only repeat the DC 11 Wisdom save, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Superior Invisibility. Magically become Invisible along with worn and carried equipment. The effect lasts while the dragon maintains Concentration as it would on a spell.
